name: EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking with VIX Regime Filter
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, ZAR, and IDR by carry-to-volatility ratio, with a VIX regime overlay. Carry = local short-term interbank rate minus US Fed Funds. Volatility = 63-day Garman-Klass realized vol on each USDXXX pair. VIX regime split: low-vol (VIX < 20) vs high-vol (VIX >= 20) using FRED VIXCLS. Outputs: cross-sectional bar ranking (current snapshot), carry-to-vol time series, regime comparison (avg carry-to-vol in low vs high VIX), and carry decomposition table.
source:
# EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking with VIX Regime Filter
# Currencies: BRL, MXN, ZAR, IDR
# Carry = local interbank rate - US Fed Funds
# Vol = 63-day Garman-Klass realized vol (annualized)
# VIX regime: low-vol (VIX < 20) vs high-vol (VIX >= 20)

# --- Data: FX OHLC ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Data: VIX from FRED (daily, longer history than common_indices) ---
vix_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS')()
vix = ffill(vix_raw.result)

# --- Data: Interest Rates (monthly, ffilled to daily) ---
# US Fed Funds rate (daily)
us_rate_raw = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
us_rate = ffill(us_rate_raw.result)

# Brazil CDI (interbank overnight rate, monthly)
br_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
br_rate = ffill(br_rate_raw.result)

# Mexico 3M TIIE (interbank rate, monthly)
mx_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')()
mx_rate = ffill(mx_rate_raw.result)

# South Africa 3M interbank rate (monthly)
za_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
za_rate = ffill(za_rate_raw.result)

# Indonesia 3M interbank rate (monthly)
id_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01IDM156N')()
id_rate = ffill(id_rate_raw.result)

# --- Route local rate to correct asset context ---
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDBRL')()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDMXN')()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDZAR')()
is_idr = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDIDR')()

# Pick the correct local rate for this asset
local_rate = conditional_select(
    is_brl.result, br_rate,
    is_mxn.result, mx_rate,
    is_zar.result, za_rate,
    is_idr.result, id_rate,
    0.0
)

# --- Carry: local rate minus US rate (in percentage points) ---
carry_pct = local_rate - us_rate

# --- Realized Volatility: 63-day Garman-Klass (annualized decimal) ---
vol_63d = volatility_estimator(type=VolatilityEstimatorType.garman_klass, period=63)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# --- Carry-to-Vol Ratio ---
# Convert carry from pct points to decimal to match vol units
carry_decimal = carry_pct / 100.0
carry_to_vol = where(is_valid(vol_63d.result) and vol_63d.result > 0.001, carry_decimal / vol_63d.result)

# --- VIX Regime ---
is_low_vix = is_valid(vix) and vix < 20.0
is_high_vix = is_valid(vix) and vix >= 20.0

# Carry-to-vol filtered by regime (sparse — for aggregation only)
ctv_low_vix = where(is_low_vix, carry_to_vol)
ctv_high_vix = where(is_high_vix, carry_to_vol)

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()()

# --- Output 1: Current Carry-to-Vol Ranking (snapshot) ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Which EM Currency Offers the Best Risk-Adjusted Carry?',
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 2: Carry-to-Vol Time Series with VIX regime bands ---
cs_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Evolution Across EM Currencies',
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Emerald, Color.Purple],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts.value, y_values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 3: Regime Comparison — Avg Carry-to-Vol in Low vs High VIX ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.grouped,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Does Carry Work Better When VIX Is Low?',
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Carry / Vol',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series_names=['VIX < 20', 'VIX >= 20'],
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=(ctv_low_vix, ctv_high_vix))

# --- Output 4: Carry Decomposition Table ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Carry Decomposition & VIX Regime Stats',
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=4,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Carry Decomposition & VIX Regime Stats',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Local Rate (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='US Rate (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry (ppt)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='63d Vol (ann.)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry/Vol', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(local_rate, us_rate, carry_pct, vol_63d.result, carry_to_vol)
